articles.title: MASINDE MULIRO UNIVERSITY (MMUST) MAKES HISTORY
articles.description: As the Only Non-Nairobi Winner in the Kenya University Esports Rankings
articles.content: MMUST has made history by becoming the first non-Nairobi university to win the Kenya University Esports Rankings. This remarkable achievement showcases the growing talent and dedication of esports players outside the capital city.
articles.author: KUER Team
